text: GGM Gastro International GmbH of Ochtrup, Germany, is the company behind GGM Gastro; its managing directors are Ferit Inan and Ömer Elma, and it is registered at Amtsgericht Steinfurt under HRB 9637.
short: GGM Gastro is the brand of GGM Gastro International GmbH (HRB 9637, Steinfurt).
